answer: Work waits on the zenith until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nectar of the next round. By the opal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work.
